sources.title: Anthropic's Claude on Google Cloud models
sources.snippet: The Anthropic Claude models on Google Cloud offer fully managed and serverless models as APIs. To use a Claude model on Agent Platform, send a request directly to the Agent Platform API endpoint. Because the Anthropic Claude models use a managed API, there's no need to provision or manage infrastructure. You can stream your Claude responses to reduce the end-user latency perception.
